3.t: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is

4.t: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths

5.t: and the mountains will be like carded wool

6.t: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺

7.t: they will be in a life of bliss

8.t: And as for those whose scale is light

9.t: their home will be the abyss

10.t: And what will make you realize what that is
